'''Nalis Quarry''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] quarry that was located southeast of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Using [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor and [[Stone/Legends|stone]] from the quarry, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Qet]] attempted to construct a [[Unfinished colossus|colossal statue]] of his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] [[Darth Vowrawn]], but the construction site and Nalis Quarry were overtaken by rebelling slaves.
